product.what_it_is_en: A free, open-source AI action agent on Android 10-16 & HarmonyOS that operates real apps inside a hidden 1:1 background VirtualDisplay, translates screens in 4.5s, handles AI calls with anti-scam defense, and plays games without interrupting your foreground screen.
how_to_use_steps: 1. Download & install Sol-Next-v9.0.7-public-arm64.apk (90 MB) via China high-speed direct mirror or GitHub Releases.
2. Open and talk immediately — includes free built-in Rust-encrypted DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (no API key needed; optional BYOK anytime in Settings).

3. Enable one-time phone automation: HarmonyOS auto-skips wireless debugging (3 taps); Android pairs once via Wireless Debugging (no PC/Root) and stays 100% connected even after turning off Wi-Fi on 5G.
4. Speak to the Dawn Orbit orb or type a command; payments, transfers, WeChat sends, and deletions always pause for explicit user confirmation.
mika_shortcomings_solved: Mika requires buying & configuring API keys before first use -> Sol Next ships with free built-in Rust-encrypted DeepSeek V4.1 Flash + universal BYOK.
Mika disconnects immediately when Wi-Fi turns off & needs tedious HarmonyOS ADB pairing -> Sol Next locks adb_enabled=1 + 127.0.0.1:5555 loopback for Wi-Fi-off 5G persistence & zero-ADB HarmonyOS.

Mika is slow (~2,400ms/step), token-heavy & drifts on scaled virtual screens -> Sol Next delivers 72ms 0-token Tier-0A APIs (33x faster), <250ms deep-links across 120+ apps, Rust 16KB JNI pruning (-74% to -97%), and 0.0px 1:1 Display 0 cloning.

Mika exposes raw engineering logs, lacks offline voice, uploads raw screen text & packs a heavy browser/Linux container attack surface -> Sol Next offers Dawn Orbit 4-screen UI, built-in 16KB offline neural ASR/TTS, minimal-attack-surface on-device Privacy Firewall, and 9 WeChat reliability fixes (0 duplicate sends).

Mika is single-language, single-tap gaming & manual slow updates -> Sol Next supports 20 global languages (RTL), 60Hz 4-finger gaming (DouDiZhu 3/3 wins, Stockfish chess, Rust Golden Spatula engine), AI anti-scam calls, and auto-popup OTA with 4-stream multi-mirror acceleration (3-8x faster).
